description: dimadb/server: the Node reference (node server/index.mjs, dependencies in dimadb/server/node_modules) against the Rust dimadb-server debug binary, which is {cargo_target_dir}/debug/dimadb-server: the shared target directory of dima-rust/tools/cargo (CARGO_TARGET_DIR, default ~/.cache/dima-rust/target), built with `tools/cargo build -p dimadb-server`. Each launch gets a fresh data directory /tmp/dimadb-rig/<side database>, wiped first, so every scenario that needs isolated data files sets restart: true. DIMADB_REDIS_DBNAME is not a usable connection: its URL is the side's MongoDB database name, which scenarios read back from GET /api/connections (data[0].url) to address that database.
